330
# A held folder inside a server folder that a first-link Discard takes along goes back with that folder, and a change inside it is a change to the held folder alone; the take-along helpers cover these forms with and without a restart.
# A change inside a taken-along folder is judged against the server entries it held at the Discard: deleting an entry another device creates, restores or moves in afterwards, alone or inside a folder, changes that entry alone, including after a restart, and a store written before membership was recorded keeps the earlier behaviour, while deleting an entry it held, wherever it sits now, or adding one the user creates or moves in, makes the discarded folder the user's.
# Once the rules let in a taken-along server folder, the discarded folder goes to the local trash and nothing is sent, when another device trashed the server folder before or after the answer and when the person discarded the folder a second time.
# A server entry another device purges after the user moved it into a discarded folder goes to the local trash with that folder, while an edit after the purge makes the folder the user's.
# These outcomes depend on persisted Discard state and on rule changes after the answer, which no existing first_link test sets up.
